Alex: Heads up — BART delay inbound: single-car disabled at 16th St. expect 20-35 min delays. anyone trying to make the 9am standup in person?
Priya: Ugh. Thanks for flagging. I was planning to bike but rain + broken bike light = nope. staying remote for morning. :umbrella:
Sam: Confirmed. Just saw the alert on the BART status page: https://www.bart.gov/alerts 'service slowed due to disabled train'.
Marta: @Alex thanks — can anyone pick up lunch for floor 4 if I end up remote? (no umbrella, no luck)
Alex: I can swing by. I’ll grab something portable. what are cravings? tacos vs pho? :taco::ramen:
Priya: tacos please. can you get a veg option? thx.
comms-bot: Office advisory: 6/22 08:30 — BART delays expected, prioritize remote work if commute crosses Mission/16th corridor. Conference room bookings remain open.
Sam: Also FYI MUNI 22/14 rerouting near Mission due to stalled truck, might be slower if you were planning to switch.
Marta: Poll: who’s still heading into the office? React with :house: if yes, :laptop: if remote today.
Alex: :house: (but later than usual)
Priya: :laptop:
Sam: :laptop: probably, depending on BART — might try Caltrain workaround.
Marta: Thanks. For anyone driving, there’s a fender-bender on 280 N by exit 2A causing backups — Waze just rerouted me.
Priya: Good to know. I’m on video for the standup but feel free to @my-name if anything urgent — I’ll be on Slack.
Alex: If anyone needs the office desk key swipe workaround — DM me. Floor 4 coffee is working but the milk fridge is out (maintenance ticket in #eng-infra).
Sam: Appreciate the updates. If commute gets worse I’ll hop on a pod near south bay and join remotely.
Marta: Ok team — staying flexible. thanks for the offers and tacos, Alex :raised_hands:
